content.text:
Confirmed — before the fix, `getInteractionMode() != ConsoleProcessInfo.INTERACTION_NEVER` at line ~78 is evaluated before `attachToProcess(consoleProcess)` is called (which is the only place that sets `consoleProcess_`). Since `consoleProcess_` is null at that point, `getInteractionMode()` always falls through to its null-default branch, so the shell-interaction setup logic never runs correctly regardless of the actual process type. The fix commit simply reintroduces the early assignment `consoleProcess_ = consoleProcess;` that was removed by `adda54c14a6`.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: adda54c14a6158a684ee56e3b1dd1df94cdbe428

## Reasoning
(1) I walked the full history of `ConsoleProgressDialog.java` with `git log -p --follow`, grepping for `getInteractionMode`/`consoleProcess_` across all revisions to see how the constructor's control flow evolved, and compared each revision against the state just before the fix commit (`cc2d5bb3f0^`).

(2) Commit `adda54c14a6158a684ee56e3b1dd1df94cdbe428` ("Wed Feb 15 14:16:41 2017 -0800", Kevin Ushey) refactored the constructor: it deleted the line `consoleProcess_ = consoleProcess;` that previously ran immediately after the argument-validation check (right before the first `getInteractionMode() != ConsoleProcessInfo.INTERACTION_NEVER)` check), and moved the assignment into a new `attachToProcess(ConsoleProcess)` method, which is invoked only at the very end of the constructor. As a result, the `getInteractionMode()` call used to decide whether to build a `ShellInteractionManager` (interactive mode) or a read-only display now runs while `consoleProcess_` is still `null`, so `getInteractionMode()` always takes its null/default branch rather than reflecting the actual process's interaction mode. A same-day follow-up commit (`6de821326e7e`) fixed a *related* symptom (the `INTERACTION_ALWAYS` shell-sizing logic) by moving that specific check into `attachToProcess` after the assignment, but it left the earlier `getInteractionMode() != INTERACTION_NEVER` check at the top of the constructor still running before `consoleProcess_` was set — so the underlying bug from `adda54c14a6` persisted.

(3) The fix commit `cc2d5bb3f0` directly reinstates `consoleProcess_ = consoleProcess;` right after the argument-validation `throw`, in the exact spot it was removed from by `adda54c14a6`, before any `getInteractionMode()` call executes. This one-to-one correspondence between the removed line and the re-added line is strong, direct evidence that `adda54c14a6` is the bug-introducing commit.

I'm fairly confident in this identification given the precise match between the deleted and re-added lines, though I did not find or run an associated test suite/issue tracker reference to further corroborate the user-visible symptom.
